_README: MANUAL LEDGER. This file is maintained by hand, not by any script.
No public dataset records urgent care openings and closures, so anything
you learn from a press release, a local paper, a site visit or a broker
goes here and the dashboard renders it alongside the NPPES proxy.
Nothing here is fetched or verified automatically. Each entry should carry
a source you can go back to.
date:   YYYY-MM-DD, best known; use the month start if only month is known

events.note: Template row showing the expected shape. The dashboard skips any entry whose operator starts with EXAMPLE.
